messages:
maria: quick sync — we need to finalize metrics for the new token-cost per-1k dashboard. runtime + infra inputs, rollout UX, and console toggles all need to line up. who can own the metric names/ingest points?

kevin: +1. i'd like a single canonical metric for cost/unit: `cost_per_1k_tokens` derived from runtime emitted `tokens` and `cost_usd` aggregates. keep naming predictable for billing joins.

sasha: we should also split out cache vs non-cache attribution. propose `cache_savings_per_1k` and `batching_efficiency_pct` as derived views. small and separate so product can display both.

alex: from the console side — product wants: default 24h view, per-route filter, and a toggle to include/exclude cached tokens. also a lightweight compare view: canary vs baseline.

jordan: infra note: we can emit `runtime_tokens_total` and `runtime_cost_usd` at the runtime proxy boundary. need to add labels: `route`, `model`, `served_variant`, `cache:hit|miss`, `batch_size_bucket`. will start a PR to add the labels to the emitter.

kevin: good. one sticky: routing fallbacks. if request routes model A -> fallback B, how attribute cost? we should include `origin_model` and `final_model` labels so we can attribute upstream intent.

maria: agree on both labels. also for rollouts add `rollout_phase: canary|stable` so dashboards can filter by deployment phase.

sasha: quick proto for derived metrics (promql-ish pseudo):
```
# tokens/cost per 5m window by model
tokens_5m = sum(rate(runtime_tokens_total[5m])) by (model)
cost_5m = sum(rate(runtime_cost_usd[5m])) by (model)
# cost per 1k tokens
(cost_5m / tokens_5m) * 1000 as cost_per_1k_tokens
# cache savings estimate
cache_hits = sum(rate(runtime_cache_hits_total[5m])) by (model)
avg_token_cost = cost_5m / tokens_5m
cache_savings_per_1k = (cache_hits * avg_tokens_per_hit * avg_token_cost) / tokens_5m * 1000
```

alex: console UX detail — expose small help text explaining `cache_savings` is an estimate using avg token size and per-hit token reduction. we should surface confidence/estimate flag.

jordan: note on batch sizing: emitting `batch_size_bucket` as `1,2-4,5-8,9+` will let you compute `batching_efficiency_pct = 1 - (observed_per_token_latency / ideal_latency)` — rough but usable. we'll include `batch_size_bucket` and histogram of `per_token_latency_ms`.

product-ops: i'll put together a wireframe tomorrow morning. can we get the sample metric names and a small dataset to prototype?

maria: action items:
- jordan/infra: emit tokens/cost/cache hit/miss/batch labels by EOD Friday (include `origin_model` + `final_model` + `rollout_phase`).
- eng-platform (kevin/sasha): add ingestion mapping and derived queries, expose `cost_per_1k_tokens`, `cache_savings_per_1k`, `batching_efficiency_pct` as canonical metrics.
- product-ops (alex): mock console controls (toggle cached tokens, per-route, canary compare).
- product-ops: send wireframe link in this thread when ready.

infra-bot: deploy started for metrics-emitter PR #4821 — https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4821 :construction_worker:

kevin: ack. i'll stub the ingestion mapping and push a proto dashboard with fake data for product to iterate on. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks everyone — will follow up with a short spec doc later today and mark owners.

product-ops: noted, will share the wireframe in #design once done.

kevin: quick question — SLA side: should we surface unit-cost alerts? e.g., sudden jump in `cost_per_1k_tokens` > 30% for 15m.

sasha: yes, but tie alerting to `rollout_phase=canary` thresholds different than stable. we don't want canary noise.

maria: agreed. record that as extra action for eng-platform to add alert docs.

kevin: final: timeline check — infra by Fri, ingestion + proto dash early next week, product mock Monday. sound realistic?

jordan: yes, infra on track. will ping here if anything slips.

maria: great — thanks.
